heading: How can I reduce an animated GIF?
introduction: FileCompresser tries a reduced color palette while preserving animation dimensions, frame delays and loop count. Maximum changes the palette size rather than applying a fixed frame rate.

sections.heading: Choose a mode for the animation
sections.body: Start with Recommended, which uses up to 128 colors. Maximum uses up to 64 and can change subtle colors more visibly. Process the animation, then play the complete download rather than checking a single frame.

sections.heading: Review motion, colors and looping
sections.body: Palette reduction can affect gradients and edges. Frame timing, frame count, dimensions, transparency and loop count are checked before a smaller candidate is offered. If timing cannot be safely preserved or no smaller result is found, the original is retained unchanged.

sections.heading: When browser processing needs a smaller input
sections.body: GIF encoding uses the media engine and can consume substantial memory. This tool accepts files up to 50 MB, but a long or complex animation may still exceed the resources available to your browser. Keep the source and try a shorter animation if processing fails.
